catalog_rule: 单资产z分数反向，示例window=20,z_entry=1.5,z_exit=0.5；资产由输入OHLCV决定
source_semantics: Rolling close z-score including current completed close. Each row starts flat; z<-1.5 -> +1, z>1.5 -> -1, otherwise zero. No persistence; z_exit=0.5 is redundant for these parameters. Source uses shifted positions times close-to-close returns.
adaptation: BTCUSDT spot only: source short targets mapped to cash. Signal at completed close, execute next open, hold units until target changes. No short or borrowed exposure.
execution: Signal computed including day t close, decision at closure; target from t filled on day t+lag open. Buy notional 95% cash, fees extra. Fractional units, no rebalance while target unchanged.
benchmark: 95% initial cash buy-and-hold from first evaluation open, same 8bps fee/2bps slippage; no final liquidation
assumptions: Author asset is input-dependent; BTCUSDT is explicit selected instance
Long-only modification removes the source short branch
Next-open execution, sizing, fees and slippage replace source close-to-close return simulation
No forced terminal liquidation; open inventory marked at final close
No leverage, borrowing, funding, tax, lot/impact model or cash yield
Zero rolling variance maps to cash, matching NaN-comparison source behavior
data_profile: Coordinator-authorized frozen spot diagnostic; not perpetual V3 bundle
prior_trials: Unknown historical count; 2023–2024 already used by other catalog strategies
selection_reason: Legally read catalog stable ID with readable source and compatible verified spot data; no performance-based selection
